text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon drops by to see me
while I'm
looking over my schedule for
today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Could you offer me some
words of
advice for my current problem?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your advice regarding the previous
cyborg
rumors was most helpful in
resolving the situation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am now aware of your problem-solving
expertise
and have come seeking your
advice once more.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My problem is that ever since the cyborg
rumors
were cleared up, I have seen an
increase in
questions regarding my
running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The other day, my roommate, Nishino
Flower,
sought my advice on how to run
faster down the
homestretch.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I formulated a hypothesis based on
experience
and submitted an answer,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to run all cool and majestic down
the
homestretch just like you, Mihono
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When running down the stretch, I focus
on only
generating power in the
anteroposterior
direction.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Antero... what now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My answer did not compute.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I then opted for a different
method—training
together on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I expected that cooperative training
would bring
about understanding.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze... W-wait, please...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-I can't... keep up...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That too resulted in failure.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have therefore decided that I am
incapable of
conveying my point and
should avoid further
attempts.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A single piece of advice offered by a
professional
would be far more efficient.
Would you be able to
guide her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...There's something that I can't shake
from her
story.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Did Nishino Flower approach her simply
because
she wanted some advice?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I believe she wanted to learn how to run
faster.
choice_data_list: I wonder why I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: I think they just wanted to talk with you.
I think they just wanted to talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am neither proficient in self-expression
nor
suited to social interaction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The probability of her wishing to interact
with
someone like me is low.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I appreciate your input.
choice_data_list: If you try talking to them, I'm sure you'll understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days later, I spot Mihono Bourbon and
Nishino
Flower chatting together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! So you like energy drinks!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I consume energy drinks to improve
efficiency
rather than because of
preference.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay! That definitely sounds like
something
you'd do.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You know what? I'm glad I'm learning
so much
about you, Bourbon! Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her confusion, I sense some joy
in her
emotionless face.
